notes.title: Hotfix Update 6/3/25
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We've just rolled out a hotfix addressing several key issues and improving the overall experience. Here’s what’s new:  

📝 Localization & Text Fixes:
- Fixed overlapping English and Spanish text—translations are now properly separated.  
- Corrected text printer formatting in specific story passages.  
- Minor spelling and grammar fixes in the Spanish localization.  
- Fixed a reference to Jake’s Paralysis that appeared incorrectly at the end of the demo.  

🎭 Character & Visual Adjustments:  
- Fixed Jake’s character mesh to prevent body parts from overlapping incorrectly.  
- Added a version of Jake without his jacket for improved scene consistency.  
- Adjusted character scaling and positioning, especially for Nina at the end of the demo.  

🎬 Animation & Timing Improvements:
- Fixed Moretto’s disappearance timing in the bar scene—now he vanishes exactly when he should.  

📸 New Item Illustrations:  
- Added key item images for important story moments: Ice Cream, Ring, Gun, and Powder Case. (More items will be added gradually!)  

We're still hard at work improving the experience, so stay tuned for more updates! Thanks for your support! 💙

notes.title: Poison Noir: Hotfix Update – March 4
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We've just rolled out a hotfix addressing several visual and text-related issues. Here’s what’s been fixed:

 🛠 Visual & Animation Fixes:


 Fixed an issue where Jake’s head was getting cut off during close-ups.
 Adjusted the zoom-out behavior so that the text box now disappears after a few seconds.
 Smoothed out Jake’s fade-in transition to prevent sudden pop-ins.
 Removed the lingering background image behind Jake at the end of a scene.
 Corrected a Live2D rendering issue where a piece of Jake’s jacket was appearing on his face.
 Fixed inconsistencies with Nina’s jacket—he no longer reappears wearing it after taking it off.
 Adjusted character heights and scaling to ensure consistency.
 Fixed missing asset transitions so that backgrounds don’t overlap.


 📝Text & Dialogue Fixes:


 Fixed inconsistencies in the script.
 Corrected incorrect text descriptions (e.g., Nina’s eyes are now properly referenced as green).
 Updated the library scene introduction—Jake no longer sees Nina under a tree.
 Fixed a dialogue inconsistency where Moretto is mentioned looking at Jake despite disappearing.
 Resolved an issue where Moretto would unintentionally reappear in the background after vanishing.
 Adjusted the English text printer, fixing formatting issues.


 🎭 Gameplay & Interaction Fixes:


 Locked choice options to prevent rollback after making a decision.
 Added missing assets for the gun, powder case, and ring.
 Updated Lucy’s visual change during her singing scene.
 Implemented camera adjustments in the park scene.


This patch also includes general improvements to scene transitions and background rendering. Let us know if you spot anything else! Thanks for your support! 💙

notes.content:
📣 Exciting News: "Jake's Paralysis" Visual Novel Demo Update! 📣

Your feedback has been invaluable to us, and we've been hard at work to make the game even more captivating.

If you haven't yet experienced "Jake's Paralysis," now is the perfect time to check it out. Download the demo today and get ready for an unforgettable visual novel adventure!

notes.title: Jake's Paralysis to te top!
notes.content:
Thank you for playing ♥

We wanted to take a moment to extend our heartfelt gratitude for your incredible support and enthusiasm in downloading the first chapter of Jake's Paralysis.

Seeing the overwhelming response from players like you has been nothing short of inspiring for our little team. Your interest in our game and the positive feedback you've shared warms our hearts and fuels our passion for creating the game.

Remember, this is just the beginning, and Team Brunomir will continue workning hard on the full game.

We leave here a photo of Jake resting after this little success, but it is not known if it will last long...
